categories.label: Chest X-ray — Pneumonia
categories.description: Screens a frontal chest X-ray for a pneumonia pattern (bacterial or viral). Trained on paediatric (age 1–5) X-rays from Kermany et al. 2018.

evaluation.set: held-out test set (patients never seen in training)

categories.caveats: Only meaningful for frontal chest X-rays similar to the training data (children aged 1–5, one hospital). Adult X-rays, other body parts, other modalities or ordinary photos produce meaningless output.
